# Loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability come from the worst C,
# I and A of each CVE's usable CVSS v3 vectors, confidentiality's in the
# column data_sensitivity picks, availability's in the one
# availability_requirement picks, and no call asks them; a CVE with no usable
# v3 vector takes 9 for each, counted. The quickstart's data is high, so
# sensitive, its availability high, so primary, and eight of its CVEs carry
# no v3 vector. Every vector stays one the calculator takes.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg --config-file=$QUICKSTART/config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'No usable CVSS v3 vector in the scanner''s report; Loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability take their worst level.* cves=8 '
stderr 'Scoring run finished.* counters.cvss_v3_missing=8 '
! stderr 'calls.LC=|calls.LI=|calls.LAV=|calls.R='
! stderr 'counters.availability_requirement_missing='
vex-vectors out.cdx.json 45
cvss-impacts dbg sensitive primary

# The system prompt no longer defines reachability, and no request asks it
# or lists an answer below an impact scale; CVE descriptions may still say
# "reachable".
exec sh -c 'cat dbg/run-*/batch-00001.system.prompt'
! stdout 'reachab'
stdout 'Choose cannot_tell only when the facts given do not decide between the other answers'
exec sh -c 'cat dbg/run-*/*.human.prompt'
! stdout 'reachability is defined'
! stdout 'not_reachable'
! stdout 'no_impact'

# Low data takes the non-sensitive column.
exec sh -c 'sed "s/data_sensitivity: \"high\"/data_sensitivity: \"low\"/" "$QUICKSTART/config.yaml" > low.yaml'
grep 'data_sensitivity: "low"' low.yaml
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg2 --config-file=low.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json out2.cdx.json
vex-vectors out2.cdx.json 45
cvss-impacts dbg2 non-sensitive primary

# Low availability takes the secondary services column, and the calls are
# the same bytes.
exec sh -c 'sed "s/availability_requirement: \"high\"/availability_requirement: \"low\"/" "$QUICKSTART/config.yaml" > lowav.yaml'
grep 'availability_requirement: "low"' lowav.yaml
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg3 --config-file=lowav.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json out3.cdx.json
! stderr 'counters.availability_requirement_missing='
vex-vectors out3.cdx.json 45
cvss-impacts dbg3 sensitive secondary
exec sh -c 'cat dbg/run-*/*.prompt > high.prompts && cat dbg3/run-*/*.prompt > low.prompts'
cmp high.prompts low.prompts

# Left out, it reads primary, and each CVE with a usable v3 vector, 37 of
# the 45, counts availability_requirement_missing once.
exec sh -c 'grep -v "^  availability_requirement:" "$QUICKSTART/config.yaml" > unset.yaml'
! grep '^  availability_requirement:' unset.yaml
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg4 --config-file=unset.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json out4.cdx.json
stderr 'Scoring run finished.* counters.availability_requirement_missing=37 counters.cvss_v3_missing=8 '
vex-vectors out4.cdx.json 45
cvss-impacts dbg4 sensitive unset
exec sh -c 'cat dbg4/run-*/*.prompt > unset.prompts'
cmp high.prompts unset.prompts
